reviews.text: Lijiang Black Dragon Pool is a very famous place to visit if you are in the area. Not just by foreigners but by locals too. The views here are stunning with a pagoda in the center to accentuate the mountain. The path is rather easy to access with quite a wide width for one to stop on the sides for photo taking. A community park by nature, this place is free to enter. It also serves as a preservation site for Ming & Qing dynasty features. If you do stop by here, you can also access an ancient town further down the line. We actually enjoyed the walk into Lijiang Old Town aka Dayan Ancient City. About 1km walk with willows by the side, a stream to accompany your walk and even bridges with seating when you are tired. Do note that they kept the old path here thus, it may be challenging due to its smaller pathway and for those who are less-abled. All in all the Park and the access to the old town, is a must to go. Ps: we added our QR for you to access other places we visited to create a smooth transition of places for your viewing pleasure. Cheers!

A park at the north of the ancient town, easily accessible both from the ancient town or from the modern city. The park itself is not huge (for china’s standard) but it has some nice building and also a gallery (or museum) which I found it’s the most attracting for me. Maybe not everyone like history or stories, but if you’re interested this is definitely a must visit. It explains about the ancient dongba civilization with some artifacts on display. It also showcase the geographical uniqueness of Yunnan in the region within Myanmar Thailand and Laos. Within the park there are cafe and restaurant as well. Toilets and dustbins are available. It’s a comfortable place to rest, slow walk, hangout.

The Dongva Culture and Research Institute and Museum was honestly the best part about the place. The museum was VERY interactive with touch screens to try caligraphy and learn about Dongba pictograph language system, audio where you can hear Naxi shamans chanting, videos that show the Naxi people's cultural habits through different life stages, info about their ethnic attire etc.

丽江黑龙潭 is an absolute gem nestled just a short distance from the ancient city of Lijiang. The moment you step into this serene park, you're greeted by breathtaking scenery that feels like stepping into a traditional Chinese painting. The tranquil waters of the Black Dragon Pool reflect the majestic Yulong Snow Mountain in the distance, creating a picture-perfect moment that’s a dream for any photographer. The park itself is meticulously maintained, with lush greenery, charming bridges, and pavilions that invite you to slow down and soak in the beauty. One of the highlights for me was visiting the Dongba Culture and Research Institute and Museum. It’s incredibly interactive, offering hands-on experiences like trying calligraphy and learning about the fascinating Dongba pictograph language. The exhibits are well-curated, providing deep insights into the local Naxi culture, which added so much depth to my visit. The weather during my stroll was pleasant, making the walk around the park all
Beautiful park good for a short walk, if its a clear sky you can see the mountain at the back ground.
Beautiful place. Enjoy the stunning view or hike your way up on the elephant mountain to get a stunning view over the city. Good to know, entrance tickets are valid for up to 7 days.
Leisure park Nice photo spot for yulong snow mountain Admissions free before 0730 In the city Nearby many eatery for breakfast, lunch and dinner
The Heilongtan part is located about 5km from ancient city of Lijiang. It is great park with very good scenery and ambient environment. Good to visit whenever comes to Lijiang.

I also love this place a lot. The view is great, the atmosphere is awesome and the pace is slow. You may come here to see the sunset. Suitable for family and couples to wander around. However, the entrance is a bit expensive, 80 RMB per head.
Beautiful park. Great scenery, and if you want to scale the 1100 steps to the top of elephant mt, it's all there for you.

Beautiful park, worth the visit. There is an entrance fee (Old Town preservation ticket, 80rmb), but if you take one of the two other entrances (both North from the main entrance), you can avoid it. The view from the park on the Jade Dragon Snow Mountain is stunning.

Scenic park with great view of nature - few hundred years trees, crystal clear pool and underground spring, view of Jade Dragon mountain, Na-xi musium, relaxing local Na-xi people doing their morning folk dance, exercise / tai-chi, peaceful stream and numerous plants and flowers. This park also connect to Gucheng 古城walk path. Beside Jade Dragon mountain, this is another must-go place for Lijiang.

Great layout with 6 classy and welll maintained bedrooms each own clean toilets. Kitchen with everything you need including consumables. A short down hill walk to old town but the uphill return trip can be a bit taxing. Very friendly and helpful owner(s).

Do make a visit if you have some spare time in the city. Nice walk around the park and require admission RMB50 per head. Before entering to the park on your left. Is a free entry Museum to explore the Naxi minority
Pretty beautiful park with English signs giving you some information​ about the history. Also has an interesting free museum about the dongba culture. A must-see place in Lijiang.

If you are visiting Lijiang, you cannot miss Hei Long Tan Park for any reason! Very close to the old town - ancient city, about a 5-minute walk, Hei Long Tan is a must for an invigorating walk. The relaxing and gorgeous park grants a plunge into timeless nature with breathtaking landscape!
A serene place to visit where one can snap photo of Jade Dragon Snow Mountain reflected in the pool.
Come in the morning and people watch. Beautiful views of the mountain reflected in the lake.
Nice garden full of beautiful flower. Relaxing, refreshing and I so enjoy with the harmony environment.
It was a great place to visit but there was no water when we visited in the pond... That was in 2014

Lijiang Black Dragon Pool Nice park with beautiful lake and mountain background. Can finish strolling around 30 min. Toilet is clean. North part have small opera area, usually got elderly doing taichi, or group having performance training. Good for wind down
Best park to visit in Lijiang area. Need to pay for 50yuan and able to use it within a month for frequent visits.
Very nice place to take a stroll at the park, but too bad we could not see the JDSM as it was cloudy

As you can see my picture taken, beautiful scenery. After our visit to the old town our guide lead us by walking to this place, that day our itinerary its really full and we already very tires especially my mom and aunts. Here also can take several beautiful shoots. Worth a visit.

This is a picture perfect park. You'll find it pristinely clean and nicely landscaped. It's a nice walk around the lake with wonderful views of the mountain, and the pagodas built around the park. Enjoy some time in the longevity pavilion.
I think the photo says it all... black dragon pool set in a beautiful park that we were supposed to walk through, but ended up 3 hours in there
Absolutely peaceful and serene lake park. Immaculate landscaping and excellent maintenance. Perfect place for a quiet walk and leisurely contemplation of the beautiful scenery.

It's a beautiful garden, brilliant for early morning walks or runs, and you will encounter a lot of the locals doing just that. Other than that, not much else interesting. The Museum isn't great either. If you've already paid the rmb80 to get into the Old Town of Lijiang, that ticket will grant you free access to this Garden too. Otherwise, it's really hard to imagine why anyone would pay that much to walk around a garden.
You need to pay if you want to visit. Love the place, love the view, they have tourist information counter as well. you can find toilet and baby room also.
Beautiful place, you will never believe such beautiful place exists on earth. Especially great experience when the weather is cool.
You have to pay 80 y to go inside You can hike to the top and see amazing view but it will take a10000 steps before ..
Fantastic view of the mountain, great place to take scenic photos. Enjoy the beautiful Moon Pavilion in the middle of the lake.
A great quiet place to have a good stroll. At early morning, it's peaceful, serene and be connected to the beautiful landscape.
The place is nice for a local slow morning walk but I wouldnt recommend for tourist to visit here.
80 Yuan per person, same as everything in lijiang. Nice small park, if you had enough of the old City than it's the right place to be
Good place for a stroll. Do remember to bring along your entry pass bought for the Dayan old town. They will check.
Nice park in Li Jiang, with small lake picturesque Chinese style buildings and great backdrop of Yulong mountain
A very nice park. Not so many people. Maybe because it charged 80 dollar per person.
In China, there is a lot of similar lake like this. However this lake is very close to ancient town.
It’s up to you if you visit this place or not. For me, it was worth visiting here.

This is a great spot to see the Sun Ray shining onto Jade Dragon Snow Mountain during sunrise. Drone is allowed here and you can capture the lake with the mountain using the drone. Be there early to get a good spot as it gets crowded early morning.
麗江黑龍潭公園也稱玉泉公園，位於雲南省麗江市古城區麗江古城北部，是麗江古城水系的源頭，以雙龍戲水，龍潭倒映十三峰的絕美景致聞名，這裡不僅是為世界文化遺產－麗江古城的一部分。更是拍攝玉龍雪山經典倒影的絕佳位置.
小而美的公園，我去的時後並沒收門票，園區內有一簡餐店，在古色古香的建築內用餐，欣賞湖面，價位也很親民，超棒的，站在五孔橋的中間，天氣好的時候可以拍到玉龍雪山，是一個絕佳的拍攝點，整個園區不是很大，可以很悠閒的走完

Công viên Hắc Long Đàm – Lệ Giang Công viên được xây dựng từ năm 1737 dưới triều nhà Thanh, là nơi lưu giữ nhiều công trình cổ như Tháp Ngũ Phượng, Đền Long Thần, mang đậm kiến trúc Nạp Tây và văn hóa Đông Ba. Hồ nước trong xanh phản chiếu núi tuyết Ngọc Long tạo nên khung cảnh huyền ảo, rất lý tưởng để chụp ảnh. 📌 Tip du lịch: - Nên đến vào sáng sớm hoặc lúc trời quang để ngắm cảnh phản chiếu đẹp nhất. - Có thể vào cổng miễn phí nếu giữ vé tham quan Phố cổ Lệ Giang. - Dành ít thời gian ghé thăm bảo tàng văn hóa Đông Ba trong công viên. Công viên có vé vào cổng hình như 50 - 80 tệ/khách. Đẹp nhất bạn nên đi vào mùa xuân hoa đào nở rộ. Nhưng mùa hè bạn đến vẫn sẽ có những bức ảnh khá chill.
Ngồi trên cầu ngắm hồ, mà thêm ly cà phê thì có thể ngồi thật lâu. Gió mát lành!
Công viên rộng, núi non hùng vĩ, khung cảnh thanh bình của hồ nước phẳng lặng, cây, hoa. Thích hợp với tản bộ thể dục, thư giãn, check in.

4月初造訪黑龍潭。根據導遊介紹黑龍潭是個湧泉的地方，水質清澈。後來因為旅遊業的發展，大量抽取地下水，湧泉不在。 黑龍潭的牌坊有四隻石獅，與眾不同。沒有踩幼獅或彩球，中間兩隻張口的獅子，不是河東獅吼的母獅，而是張口大笑的雄獅。聽這解說，覺得非常有趣。 黑龍潭也是拍攝玉龍雪山最佳地點之一。天氣好，可拍的玉龍雪山倒影。潭中有一樓高三層的得月樓，有郭沫若所提對聯。園內花木扶疏，生意盎然，還有詩社、木雕可逛，充滿人文風情。

흑룡담공원( Black Dragon Pool Park. 1 Minzhu Rd, Gucheng District, Lijiang, Yunnan, China 674100)은 여강 시내 북쪽에 위치한 여강의 대표 공원으로 여강 고성에서 700m정도 떨어져 있습니다. 유서 깊은 사찰이 산 중턱에 자리잡고 있으며 연못과 버드나무 누각 대리석교가 어울어져 한폭의 멋진 동양화를 보는 듯 합니다. 멀리 보이는 옥룡설산을 배경삼아 사진을 찍으면 그림같이 나옵니다.추적추적 내리던 비도 그치고 산책로를 따라 걸으니 더 없는 상쾌함이 느껴지고 청량감이 듭니다. 호수면을 유영하고 있는 백조까지 있어 완벽한 조화를 이룹니다. 흑룡담이라는 명칭이 무색하게 물빛이 영롱한 옥색으로 보여 옥룡담으로 불러도 될만큼 맑고 투명한 에메랄드 색깔입니다. 흑룡담의 물이 여강고성으로 흘러가고 여강을 이룬다고 하니 나시족이 옥룡설산을 신성하게 여긴 것은 당연한 일이라는 깨닫게 해줍니다.명청대에 지어진 나시족의 건축물,오봉루,동파문화박물관들이 있어 아름다운 풍광과 더불어 나시족의 역사와 문화를 엿볼 수 있는 시간이 되었다. 입장료는 50원으로 Open시간은 07~19시입니다.

สระน้ำมังกรดำ (黑龙潭, Heillongtan) หรืออีกชื่อหนึ่ง สวนยวี่เฉวียน (玉泉) อยู่ไม่ไกลจากเมืองเก่าลี่เจียง ประมาณ 1 กิโลเมตรกว่าๆ สามารถเดินได้ แนะนำให้เดินมาดีกว่ามีอะไรให้ดูเยอะแยะ ฟิวมันสวนสาธารณะ ร่มรื่น สะอาด มีที่นั่งพักผ่อนหย่อนใจ สบายๆ ด้านหลังมีเขาหิมะมังกรหยกเป็นฉากหลังไกลๆ ชอบที่นี่สวยดีบรรยากาศดีเยี่ยม *แนะนำให้มาช่วงเย็นๆ ไม่ต้องเสียค่าตั๋ว เข้าฟรีได้เลย คนท้องถิ่นแนะนำมา ผมจำเวลาที่แน่นอนไม่ได้น่าจะ 17.00 น. ผมเข้าประตูทางทิศใต้ที่ติดกับเมืองเก่าลี่เจียง **ลองเที่ยวเมืองจีนสักครั้งแล้วคุณจะรัก สิบปากว่าไม่เท่าตาเห็น ไปมา ช่วงมีนาคม 2567
Công viên Hắc Long Đàm vào mùa xuân rất đẹp. Trong chuyến du lịch đến Lệ Giang tôi đã ghé thăm công viên này. Phí vào cửa là 50 rmb/người. Mùa xuân thời tiết mát mẻ, nhiều hoa anh đào nở rộ.
เดินจากเมืองเก่าลี่เจียงมาไม่ไกล เส้นทางร่มรื่น มาเจอสระน้ำ ที่มีสะพานหิน เก๋งจีนโบราณ ศาลากลางน้ำ มีปลา ฉากหลังเป็นภูเขาหิมะมังกรหยก ถ้าโชคดี จะได้ถ่ายภาพสะท้อนน้ำ ไม่ค่อยมีอะไรมีแต่วิวถ่ายภาพ

Công viên Hắc Long Đàm được xây từ những năm 1737, trải qua vô số thăng trầm, nơi đây được xem là minh chứng rõ ràng nhất cho một thời kỳ hưng thịnh và phồn vinh Lệ Giang cổ trấn. Điều đặc biệt khiến du khách mê mẩn ở công viên này còn là nghệ thuật tái hiện lại trọn vẹn kiến trúc và văn hóa Trung Hoa xưa hòa trộn với khung cảnh hùng vĩ của núi tuyết Ngọc Long. Nơi đây nổi tiếng với nhiều đền, điện như Ngũ Phượng Lâu, Nguyệt Điện, Đền Phúc Quốc,… Đặc biệt trong đó tháp Ngũ Phượng Lầu là điểm đến được nhiều du khách yếu thích nhất. Tòa tháp được xây dựng theo kiến trúc Phật giáo Tây Tạng, kiến trúc tinh xảo bậc nhất trong kiến trúc Trung Quốc xưa và nay. Công viên Hắc Long Đàm còn sở hữu một hồ nước trong vắt rộng 40 hecta, đón nguồn nước tự nhiên từ Ngọc Long Tuyết Sơn, nơi cư ngụ của hàng trăm loài động thực vật sinh sống dưới nước và ven hồ. Hình ảnh núi tuyết hùng vĩ phản chiếu lên mặt hồ lung linh thật yên bình và thơ mộng. Nguồn nước chính cho hồ này chính là dòng nước tinh khiết từ núi tuyết Ngọc Long. Ở giữa hồ Hắc Long Đàm là cầu Năm Nhịp. Trên đó được chạm khắc lối kiến trúc cổ xưa của Trung Quốc như voi, hổ, phượng hoàng,… vô cùng tinh xảo. Gần cầu Năm Nhịp là đài Thưởng Nguyệt – nơi các vua chúa Trung Hoa thời xưa thường ghé thăm để thư giãn, ngắm trăng và vịnh thơ. Đứng từ tọa độ này, du khách có thể chiêm ngưỡng được trọn vẹn vẻ đẹp của công viên Hắc Long Đàm.

เป็นสวนอยู่ในลี่เจียง ไม่ไกลจากถนนคนเดินโบราณฃี่เจียง บรรยากาศดี ต้นไม้ดอกไม้สวย สระมังกรดำ ที่สามารถเห็นวิวเขาหิมะมังกรหยก แต่วันที่ไปมีหมอกลง ทำให้บดบังตัวเขา กล้องถ่ายไม่เห็น แต่ถ้ามองด้วยตาเปบ่าจะเห็นลางๆ
리장고성에서 2.5km쯤 거리라 걸어서 산책할만 합니다. 날씨 좋으면 호수 저 멀리 옥룡설산 풍경이 압권입니다. 입장료가 100위안인데 웨이신(위쳇) 결제만 되고 알리페이는 안됩니다. 왼쪽 개울가 따라 올라가면 샛길이 있더군요.

สระมังกรดำ สวนสาธารณะที่มีอาคารศิลปะจีนโบราณ กลางเมืองลี่เจียง ต้องซื้อตั๋วเข้าชมด้านใน ด้านในมีสระน้ำขนาดใหญ่ ที่มีหมู่อาคารจีแบบโบราณ สะพานหิน ที่มี Background เป็นภูเขาหิมะมังกรหยก และสะท้อนเงาลงบนผืนน้ำ มีสวนอันร่มรื่น เงียบสงบให้เดินเล่น นั่งพักผ่อน มีร้านคาเฟ่เล็กๆ มีห้องน้ำบริการด้านใน หลักๆ เหมาะกับการถ่ายรูปกับวิวสวยๆ โดยใช้เวลาสั้นๆ
Wunderschöner Park mit vielen Gebäuden und einer Brücke. Sehr schön bei schönem Wetter mit den Bergen im Hintergrund. Empfehlenswert. Eintritt 50 YUAN.

位于丽江古城中心地带，面积625.3万平方米，为世界文化遗产－丽江古城的一部分。 这里是游客著名打卡地，最出名的是在晴天的日子，可以从这里眺望远处的玉龙雪山，无风的时间还能从水面拍出玉龙雪山的水中倒影。当然，这需要些运气。 黑龙潭有众多泉水，泉群主要由象山东麓的九子海洼地及其周边山系的泉水补给，潭水经玉河向南流入丽江古城，是丽江古城水系的主要来源。 景区内典型传统古建筑始建于清乾隆二年（公元1737年）。2006年公布为第六批全国重点文物保护单位，包括文明坊（即黑龙潭大门）、锁翠桥、得月楼、龙神祠、光碧楼、一文亭、五凤楼、解脱林门楼、戏台9个建筑，解脱林门楼、五凤楼、光碧楼、一文亭、文明坊5座建筑为从其他地方迁建于此。2009年被评为国家4A级旅游景区

(22/03/2024) สระมังกรดำ อยู่ไม่ไกลจากตัวเมืองโบราณลี่เจียง ว่ากันว่าทิวทัศน์ตรงนี้สวยที่สุดมุมหนึ่งในประเทศจีน ผมโชคร้ายมาช่วงเย็น ฟ้าปิด ฝนตก เลยไม่ได้เห็นวิวของภูเขาหิมะมังกรหยกด้านหลัง ที่จะสะท้อนกับน้ำคงเป็นภาพสวยงามยากจะลืม แต่ก็ได้เห็นเท่าที่อากาศเป็นใจได้แค่นี้แหละครับ สวยอยู่นะ
Công viên Hắc Long Đàm có cảnh quan tuyệt đẹp. Không khí trong lành. Không quá khó khăn di chuyển. Người lớn tuổi hay trẻ em vẫn có thể thoải mái thưởng cảnh và tham quan
วันทีไปมีน้องที่อยู่จีนให้ลิ่งทำให้ไม่เสียค่าเช่า อยู่ใกล้โซนเมืองเก่า เป็นวัดเก่าแก่ วิวด้านหลังเผ็นภูเขาหิมะสวย อากาศดีมีคาเฟ่ด้านใน บรรยากาศสบายๆ

·黑龙潭原是丽江的一个龙王庙，庙旁泉眼众多，积水成潭。因为泉水如玉，能倒映玉龙雪山，也称“玉泉公园”。 ·这里既是丽江古城的水源地，也是丽江国家级保护文物最集中的地方。 ·以五孔桥、得月楼、雪山及黑龙潭中的雪山倒影，组成了丽江的经典风光明信片。 ·黑龙潭是拍摄玉龙雪山取景最好的地方，最好早上和傍晚来拍摄，此时的雪山的光线最好。

黑龍潭公園也稱玉泉公園，位於麗江古城北部，總占地面積625.3萬平方米，海拔2419米，為 世界文化遺產－麗江古城的一部分。黑龍潭泉群主要由象山東麓的九子海窪地及其周邊山系的泉水補給，潭水經玉河向南流入麗江古城，是麗江古城水系的主要來源。 黑龍潭風景區的古建築始建於清乾隆二年（公元1737年），由文明坊，鎖翠橋、一文亭、解脫林、光碧樓、戲台、龍神祠、得月樓和五鳳樓九個單體組成。1996年列為雲南省重點文物保護單位，2006年被列為國家級重點文物保護單位。2009年被評為國家4A級旅遊景區。
